summary:
We have developed an interactive website dedicated to historical space missions and technologies. Our site addresses the issue of the technologies that started it all being forgotten due to the rapid advancement of astronomy. It is important to remember the instruments of the past, as they still offer a wealth of interesting information and valuable experience. With an intuitive interface featuring an animated solar system and a structured database of space equipment, users can explore key lunar and Martian instruments using interactive cards that describe in detail their technical parameters, history and their mission. Our task is to ensure that the origins of today’s discoveries are not forgotten.
Designed for schoolchildren, students, teachers and enthusiasts of any level of training.
details:
Our project is an interactive website dedicated to historical space missions and scientific instruments. It is built as a single responsive page powered by a structured JavaScript database. Set against an animated Solar System background, users can click on any of the instruments to open a detailed description featuring launch dates, mission objectives, technical specifications, and the scientific discoveries of that spacecraft. The main screen displays a dark, space-themed interface featuring an animated model of the Solar System and five interactive cards representing spacecraft. It automatically adjusts the card grid and font sizes to fit the screen of a smartphone, tablet, or PC. All texts, specifications, launch dates, scientific discoveries, and paths to images are stored in a structured JavaScript object. Designed for school students, university students, educators, and enthusiasts of any skill level, our goal is to preserve the memory of outstanding space inventions of the past, increase public interest in astronomy, and show which technologies laid the foundation for modern discoveries.
Languages: HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript
Hosting: GitHub, deployed publicly via GitHub Pages
AI Assistance Disclosure: Generative AI tools were used during development strictly to assist with code structuring.
